description: This file defines a script that deletes a user-role relationship in the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves a Role bean, clears the relationship with a specified user, and redirects to a specified URL.

methods.name: $focus->retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the Role bean with the specified record ID.

methods.name: $focus->clear_user_relationship
methods.description: Removes the relationship between the role and the specified user.
